about: arXiv issue 39. VERT's pinned rustc (nightly-2023-07-29, artifacts/vert/benchmark/rust-toolchain.toml) vs the primary's 1.86.0, same session, same image, on the grid the defect count uses: scalar grid v2 (baseline results/vert_diff_grid2.json) and the array/float generator (baseline results/vert_arrays_fixed.json). Whole harnesses, every accepted function.
script: systems/vert/arxiv_pinned_grid2.py (wraps systems/vert/toolchain_pinned.py, which wraps systems/vert/run.py and systems/vert/run_arrays.py unchanged)

summary_nightly.headline: value_bug = genuine wrong-answer on inputs the ORIGINAL C handles without UB (ASan/UBSan-filtered); rust_panic and ub_only are reported separately and are NOT counted as wrong answers
summary_nightly.grid: v2: per-arg v1 grid + powers of two +-1 + range ends; 1-arg untruncated; multi-arg spread (R_d) over the v2 grids
